message.name: PaymentReturnV15
message.definition: Scope|The PaymentReturn message is sent by an agent to the previous agent in the payment chain to undo a payment previously settled.|Usage|The PaymentReturn message is exchanged between agents to return funds after settlement of credit transfer instructions (that is FIToFICustomerCreditTransfer message and FinancialInstitutionCreditTransfer message) or direct debit instructions (FIToFICustomerDirectDebit message).|The PaymentReturn message should not be used between agents and non-financial institution customers. Non-financial institution customers will be informed about a debit or a credit on their account(s) through a BankToCustomerDebitCreditNotification message ('notification') and/or BankToCustomerAccountReport/BankToCustomerStatement message ('statement').|The PaymentReturn message can be used to return single instructions or multiple instructions from one or different files.|The PaymentReturn message can be used in domestic and cross-border scenarios.|The PaymentReturn message refers to the original instruction(s) by means of references only or by means of references and a set of elements from the original instruction.

rules.name: IdentificationOrProxyPresenceRule
rules.text: Identification must be present or Proxy must be present. Both may be present.

rules.name: IdentificationAndProxyGuideline
rules.text: If the account identification is not defined through a conventional identification such as an email address or a mobile number, then the proxy element should be used for the identification of the account.

rules.name: ThirdReimbursementAgentRule
rules.text: If ThirdReimbursementAgent is present, then InstructingReimbursementAgent and InstructedReimbursementAgent must both be present.

rules.name: SettlementMethodAgentRule
rules.text: If SettlementMethod is equal to INDA or INGA, then ReimbursementAgent(s) and ClearingSystem are not allowed.

rules.name: SettlementMethodCoverRule
rules.text: If SettlementMethod is equal to COVE, then SettlementAccount and ClearingSystem are not allowed.

rules.name: SettlementMethodCoverAgentRule
rules.text: If SettlementMethod is equal to COVE, then InstructedReimbursementAgent or InstructingReimbursementAgent must be present.

rules.name: SettlementMethodClearingRule
rules.text: If SettlementMethod is equal to CLRG, then SettlementAccount and ReimbursementAgent(s) are not allowed.

rules.name: InstructingReimbursementAgentAccountRule
rules.text: If InstructingReimbursementAgentAccount is present, then InstructingReimbursementAgent must be present.

rules.name: InstructedReimbursementAgentAccountRule
rules.text: If InstructedReimbursementAgentAccount is present, then InstructedReimbursementAgent must be present.

rules.name: ThirdReimbursementAgentAccountRule
rules.text: If ThirdReimbursementAgentAccount is present, then ThirdReimbursementAgent must be present.

rules.name: GroupReturnAndNumberOfTransactionsGuideline
rules.text: If GroupReturn is true, then NumberOfTransactions equals the number of transactions in the original message.

rules.name: TotalInterbankSettlementAmountAndDateRule
rules.text: If TotalReturnedInterbankSettlementAmount is present, then InterbankSettlementDate must be present.

rules.name: ControlSumAndGroupReturnRule
rules.text: If GroupReturn is true, then ControlSum is not allowed.

rules.name: ReturnReasonRule
rules.text: If Reason/Code is equal to NARR, then AddititionalInformation must be present.

rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
rules.text: This component may not be used without the explicit approval of a SEG and submission to the RA of ISO 20022 compliant structure(s) to be used in the Envelope element.

rules.name: AmendmentIndicatorTrueRule
rules.text: If AmendmentIndicator is true, then AmendmentInformationDetails must be present.

rules.name: AmendmentIndicatorFalseRule
rules.text: If AmendmentIndicator is false, then AmendmentInformationDetails is not allowed.

rules.name: RemittanceAmountAndTypeGuideline
rules.text: If Type/Code is equal to CREN, DUPA or REMI for RemittanceAmountAndType, RemittanceAmountAndType must not be repeated.

rules.name: TransactionIdentificationPresenceRule
rules.text: TransactionIdentification or UETR must be present. Both may be present

rules.name: UltimateDebtorGuideline
rules.text: UltimateDebtor may only be present if different from Debtor.

rules.name: UltimateCreditorGuideline
rules.text: UltimateCreditor may only be present if different from Creditor.

rules.name: IntermediaryAgent2Rule
rules.text: If IntermediaryAgent2 is present, then IntermediaryAgent1 must be present.

rules.name: IntermediaryAgent3Rule
rules.text: If IntermediaryAgent3 is present, then IntermediaryAgent2 must be present.

rules.name: IntermediaryAgent1AccountRule
rules.text: If IntermediaryAgent1Account is present, then IntermediaryAgent1 must be present.

rules.name: IntermediaryAgent2AccountRule
rules.text: If IntermediaryAgent2Account is present, then IntermediaryAgent2 must be present.

rules.name: IntermediaryAgent3AccountRule
rules.text: If IntermediaryAgent3Account is present, then IntermediaryAgent3 must be present.

rules.name: PreviousInstructingAgent1AccountRule
rules.text: If PreviousInstructingAgent1Account is present, then PreviousInstructingAgent1 must be present.

rules.name: PreviousInstructingAgent2AccountRule
rules.text: If PreviousInstructingAgent2Account is present, then PreviousInstructingAgent2 must be present.

rules.name: PreviousInstructingAgent3AccountRule
rules.text: If PreviousInstructingAgent3Account is present, then PreviousInstructingAgent3 must be present.

rules.name: PreviousInstructingAgent1Guideline
rules.text: It is recommended that, when present, PreviousInstructingAgent1 is the closest to the DebtorAgent in the payment chain.

rules.name: PreviousInstructingAgent2Rule
rules.text: If PreviousInstructingAgent2 is present, then PreviousInstructingAgent1 must be present.

rules.name: PreviousInstructingAgent3Rule
rules.text: If PreviousInstructingAgent3 is present, then PreviousInstructingAgent2 must be present.

rules.name: UnderlyingAllocationGuideline
rules.text: UnderlyingAllocation may only be present if bilaterally agreed.

rules.name: UltimateDebtorGuideline
rules.text: UltimateDebtor may only be present if different from Debtor.

rules.name: UltimateCreditorGuideline
rules.text: UltimateCreditor may only be present if different from Creditor.

rules.name: IntermediaryAgent2Rule
rules.text: If IntermediaryAgent2 is present, then IntermediaryAgent1 must be present.

rules.name: IntermediaryAgent3Rule
rules.text: If IntermediaryAgent3 is present, then IntermediaryAgent2 must be present.

rules.name: IntermediaryAgent1Rule
rules.text: If IntermediaryAgent1 is present, then CreditorAgent must be present.

rules.name: IntermediaryAgent1AccountRule
rules.text: If IntermediaryAgent1Account is present, then IntermediaryAgent1 must be present.

rules.name: IntermediaryAgent2AccountRule
rules.text: If IntermediaryAgent2Account is present, then IntermediaryAgent2 must be present.

rules.name: IntermediaryAgent3AccountRule
rules.text: If IntermediaryAgent3Account is present, then IntermediaryAgent3 must be present.

rules.name: DebtorAgentAccountRule
rules.text: If DebtorAgentAccount is present, then DebtorAgent must be present.

rules.name: CreditorAgentAccountRule
rules.text: If CreditorAgentAccount is present, then CreditorAgent must be present.

rules.name: PreviousInstructingAgent1AccountRule
rules.text: If PreviousInstructingAgent1Account is present, then PreviousInstructingAgent1 must be present.

rules.name: PreviousInstructingAgent2AccountRule
rules.text: If PreviousInstructingAgent2Account is present, then PreviousInstructingAgent2 must be present.

rules.name: PreviousInstructingAgent3AccountRule
rules.text: If PreviousInstructingAgent3Account is present, then PreviousInstructingAgent3 must be present.

rules.name: PreviousInstructingAgent2Rule
rules.text: If PreviousInstructingAgent2 is present, then PreviousInstructingAgent1 must be present.

rules.name: PreviousInstructingAgent3Rule
rules.text: If PreviousInstructingAgent3 is present, then PreviousInstructingAgent2 must be present.

rules.name: PreviousInstructingAgent1Guideline
rules.text: It is recommended that, when present, PreviousInstructingAgent1 is the closest to the DebtorAgent in the payment chain.

rules.name: UnderlyingCustomerCreditTransferRule
rules.text: The UnderlyingCustomerCreditTransfer element can only be present if present in the original transaction being returned.

rules.name: UnderlyingFinancialInstitutionCreditTransferRule
rules.text: The UnderlyingFinancialInstitutionCreditTransfer element can only be present if present in the original transaction being returned.

rules.name: IntermediaryAgent1AccountRule
rules.text: If IntermediaryAgent1Account is present, then IntermediaryAgent1 must be present.

rules.name: IntermediaryAgent2AccountRule
rules.text: If IntermediaryAgent2Account is present, then IntermediaryAgent2 must be present.

rules.name: IntermediaryAgent3AccountRule
rules.text: If IntermediaryAgent3Account is present, then IntermediaryAgent3 must be present.

rules.name: PreviousInstructingAgent1AccountRule
rules.text: If PreviousInstructingAgent1Account is present, then PreviousInstructingAgent1 must be present.

rules.name: PreviousInstructingAgent2AccountRule
rules.text: If PreviousInstructingAgent2Account is present, then PreviousInstructingAgent2 must be present.

rules.name: PreviousInstructingAgent3AccountRule
rules.text: If PreviousInstructingAgent3Account is present, then PreviousInstructingAgent3 must be present.

rules.name: ReturnedInstructedAmountAndExchangeRate1Rule
rules.text: If ReturnedInstructedAmount is present and the currency is different from the currency in ReturnedInterbankSettlementAmount, then ExchangeRate must be present.

rules.name: ReturnedInstructedAmountAndExchangeRate2Rule
rules.text: If ReturnedInstructedAmount is present and the currency is the same as the currency in ReturnedInterbankSettlementAmount, then ExchangeRate is not allowed.

rules.name: ChargesInformationAndReturnedInstructedAmountRule
rules.text: If ChargesInformation is present, then ReturnedInstructedAmount must be present.

rules.name: InstructedAgentRule
rules.text: If GroupHeader/InstructedAgent is present, then TransactionInformation/InstructedAgent is not allowed.

rules.name: InstructingAgentRule
rules.text: If GroupHeader/InstructingAgent is present, then TransactionInformation/InstructingAgent is not allowed.

rules.name: GroupReturnAndNumberOfTransactionsRule
rules.text: If GroupHeader/GroupReturn is false, then GroupHeader/NumberOfTransactions must equal the number of occurrences of TransactionInformation.

rules.name: GroupReturnAndReturnReasonRule
rules.text: If GroupHeader/GroupReturn is true, then OriginalGroupInformation/ReturnReasonInformation/ReturnReason must be present.

rules.name: TotalReturnedInterbankSettlementAmountRule
rules.text: If GroupHeader/TotalReturnedInterbankSettlementAmount is present, then all occurrences of TransactionInformation/ReturnedInterbankSettlementAmount must have the same currency as the currency of GroupHeader/TotalReturnedInterbankSettlementAmount.

rules.name: TotalReturnedInterbankSettlementAmountAndSumRule
rules.text: GroupHeader/TotalReturnedInterbankSettlementAmount must equal the sum of all occurrences of TransactionInformation/ReturnedInterbankSettlementAmount when present.

rules.name: OriginalGroupInformationRule
rules.text: If OriginalGroupInformation is present, then TransactionInformation/OriginalGroupInformation is not allowed.

rules.name: NoCoverSettlementMethodRule
rules.text: GroupHeader/SettlementInformation/SettlementMethod must be different from COVE (Cover) when returning direct debit transactions.

rules.name: GroupHeaderInterbankSettlementDateRule
rules.text: If GroupHeader/InterbankSettlementDate is present, then TransactionInformation/InterbankSettlementDate is not allowed.

rules.name: TransactionInterbankSettlementDateRule
rules.text: If GroupHeader/InterbankSettlementDate is not present, then TransactionInformation/InterbankSettlementDate must be present.

rules.name: GroupReturnAndTransactionInformationNotPresentRule
rules.text: If GroupHeader/GroupReturn is true, then TransactionInformation is not allowed.

rules.name: GroupReturnAndTransactionInformationPresentRule
rules.text: If GroupHeader/GroupReturn is false, then at least one occurrence of TransactionInformation must be present.

rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
rules.text: The SupplementaryData building block at message level must not be used to provide additional information about a transaction. The SupplementaryData element at transaction level should be used for that purpose.

rules.name: PaymentTypeInformationRule
rules.text: If GroupHeader/PaymentTypeInformation is present, then TransactionInformation/PaymentTypeInformation is not allowed.
